bullets.title: CMCSA: Multi-firm upgrade wave on spinoff; SOTP implies ~$29-32/share value unlock
bullets.body: Deutsche Bank upgraded CMCSA to Buy (PT $32) and Rosenblatt upgraded to Buy (PT $31) following the announced Comcast/NBCUniversal-Sky split into two public companies, expected to close ~mid-2027. UBS notes NBCU/Sky trading at 0-3x EBITDA vs. 7-13x comps; Citi and JPM both flagged CMCSA/CHTR combination as a longer-term possibility. S&P Global put CMCSA on CreditWatch Negative, viewing the connectivity business as weaker post-split with reduced diversification. Peacock projected to reach profitability by 2032; NBCUniversal exploring digital gaming M&A post-split.

bullets.title: TTD: Arete downgrades to Sell with $11.60 PT, implying 38% downside
bullets.body: Arete Research cut Trade Desk to Sell from Neutral with a $11.60 price target vs. the $18.65 stock price at time of downgrade—a 38% implied downside. FactSet consensus average PT is $25.41. Stock was down 3.8% pre-market with no additional catalyst beyond the Arete action.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Morgan Stanley raises PT to $415 on 9GW 2028 capacity and Cloud inflection
bullets.body: MS's Brian Nowak raised GOOGL PT to $415 (from $375), implying 20% upside, modeling 9GW incremental compute capacity in 2028 (7GW TPU + 2GW NVIDIA GPU). Google Cloud projected to grow 106%/44% in 2027/2028 reaching $300bn+ revenue; 2028 EPS modeled at $19; capex raised to $350bn/$375bn in 2027/2028. GOOGL trading at 18x 2028 EPS vs. 21x long-term average, described as a buying opportunity.

bullets.title: ENPH/solar: Trump admin inverter import ban draft sends solar stocks up 10-15%
bullets.body: Reuters reported the Trump administration is drafting a ban on foreign (primarily Chinese) solar inverter imports over concerns China could use them to disrupt US power supplies. ENPH and SEDG each surged 15%+ on the news; broader solar names up 3-11% pre-market.

bullets.title: AFRM: Piper Sandler initiates at Overweight alongside payments sector coverage launch
bullets.body: Piper Sandler (Bill Carcache) initiated AFRM at Overweight ($81.79 reference price) as part of a broad payments coverage launch also initiating V, MA, AXP, COF at Overweight and PYPL at Neutral. Piper views AFRM and payment networks as durable compounders at reset valuations, though flags BNPL loss rates screening poorly vs. traditional credit and labor market risk for card issuers.

bullets.title: AVGO: Jefferies bull case points to $30-40 CY'28 EPS at $225B revenue/20GW capacity
bullets.body: Jefferies' Blayne Curtis ran scenario analysis on AVGO showing CY'28 EPS of $30-40 assuming $225B revenue at 20GW AI ASIC capacity. NVDA DC compute revenue estimated ~20% above consensus for 2H FY'27 on Rubin ramp resolution. Both names cited as core AI infrastructure longs.

bullets.title: DLR: $7.8B NOVA data center acquisition; Citi maintains Buy at $226 PT
bullets.body: DLR is acquiring Blackstone's interest in three fully leased Northern Virginia data centers at $7.8B gross value (~$3.5B cash/stock to Blackstone), increasing DLR ownership from ~36% to 100%. Deal expected ~80bps accretive to Core FFOPS in 2027 and ~330bps in 2028 at >6.5% initial cap rate. Citi maintains Buy with $226 PT (18.6% upside); stock was down 2.4-4.5% post-announcement on equity issuance dilution (~$1.2B ATM + $2.3B to Blackstone).

bullets.title: NVDA/semis: SOX +81% best quarter since 1994; vol at 1Y highs with realized far above implied
bullets.body: SOX index posted +81% in Q2 2026, the best quarterly return since 1994; NDX +25% best since Q2 2020. Citi notes SMH realized vol at 72.1 (1Y highs), 19.3pts above 1M implied of 52.9. NVDA was down 6.6% w/w, MRVL -9.8%, MU -5.5%, SNDK -9.8%. ETF flows remain bullish with $1.8B into levered NVDA and $0.7B into SNDK last week. JPM notes HF semis positioning at +3z zscore with potential mean reversion risk.

bullets.title: TSM: Mizuho and MS both raising PTs ahead of July 16 earnings; 40% YoY guide expected
bullets.body: Mizuho supply chain checks confirm TSMC is expected to raise 2026 revenue guidance to ~40% YoY growth and capex to $56-57bn at July 16 earnings. N3 monthly capacity to reach 170k by 2026; CoWoS raised to 140k by 2026. Morgan Stanley's Charlie Chan raised TSMC PT to NT$2,888 (from NT$2,588) with 3Q26 revenue forecast up low-to-mid teens Q/Q. Equipment and wafer pricing up 5-15% across the supply chain from Q2.

bullets.title: AMZN: AWS EC2 Capacity Block prices raised ~20% effective July 1; second hike this year
bullets.body: Channel checks confirm AWS raised EC2 Capacity Block prices ~20% effective July 1, the second increase this year following a ~15% hike in January, validating hyperscaler pricing power for GPU compute. AMZN also shifting to token-based pricing with Anthropic. Australian regulator ACCC commenced Federal Court proceedings against Amazon over allegedly unfair Prime subscription terms affecting 1M+ subscribers.

bullets.title: MS trade: Short YTD AI winners (semis/memory/CPUs), long hyperscalers via MSFT call spreads
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley recommends shorting the MS Broad AI index (+73% YTD) and memory/CPU baskets—which have deeply negative beta to financial conditions at historical extremes—if 2yr yields break above 4.2%. Offsetting long: Buy MSFT Jan 15 410 calls / sell 2x Jan 15 470 calls at near-zero cost (ref $373). MSFT implied vol jumped to 5-year highs at 37 after a 37% decline from the October high.

bullets.title: GLW: +41% in 1 month puzzles JPM; Jefferies flags NVDA long-haul network as catalyst
bullets.body: GLW surged 24% in one week and 41% in one month, becoming the second-best performer over the last 5 days. JPM views the move as unjustified—GlassWorks AI Platform was announced 9 months ago at ECOC and JPM does not see Glass Bridge as incremental to the $10B photonics MAP target. Jefferies attributes the move to short covering and a Needham note about NVDA long-haul network buildout demand.

bullets.title: SNDK: Best H1 2026 single stock at +765%; INTU worst at -60%
bullets.body: Jefferies' midyear recap flags SNDK as the top single-stock performer in 1H 2026 at approximately +765%, riding the memory/AI storage theme. INTU was the worst performer at -60%. Memory names dominating ETF flows with $0.7B into SNDK levered products last week alongside $1.8B into levered NVDA.

bullets.title: DIS: JPM raises F27 PT to $140; Wolfe maintains OP at $131 cut PT on higher DTC costs
bullets.body: JPM raised DIS F27 PT to $140 (OW maintained), boosting F3Q adj. EPS to $1.85 and FY adj. EPS to $6.66 (+12%); Toy Story 5 tracking for ~$1.3B franchise record. Wolfe maintained Outperform but cut PT $3 to $131 on faster DTC opex growth (FY'27 OI $120M below consensus, FY'28 $260M below), with 30-35% incremental DTC margins expected. DIS trades at 13.5x NTM P/E, down 13.3% YTD vs SPX +8.7%.

bullets.title: CRM: De-rated to 10x FY28 FCF; Piper sees organic acceleration intact for back-half FY27
bullets.body: Piper's morning call notes CRM IR confirmed expectations for organic back-half FY27 revenue acceleration are unchanged, with NNAOV strength and Agentforce/Slack momentum intact. Stock has de-rated to ~10x FY28 EV/FCF despite accelerating internal innovation and AWU growth in top customers—flagged as a valuation disconnect.

bullets.title: PLTR/NVDA: Launch 'AI Engine' for US government
bullets.body: Palantir and NVIDIA jointly launched an AI Engine product targeting US government deployments, per the SaaS daily. No financial details provided but noted as a positive catalyst for both names in government AI infrastructure.

bullets.title: SMCI: Taiwan offices raided in Nvidia chip-smuggling investigation
bullets.body: Super Micro Computer's Taiwan offices were raided by Taiwanese authorities in an expanded investigation into alleged NVIDIA chip smuggling into China. No financial impact quantified yet but adds regulatory/headline risk to an already pressure-tested name.

bullets.title: TSLA: China EV sales +39% YoY in May; domestic demand surges +82% MoM but exports slip
bullets.body: Tesla China total EV deliveries reached 85,982 units in May (+8.2% m/m, +39.4% y/y). Domestic sales surged 82.2% m/m to 47,281 units while exports declined 27.7% m/m to 38,701 units. Strong YoY trajectory intact but monthly export softness warrants monitoring.

bullets.title: NOK: Jefferies models 15% EPS beat vs consensus in '27 on hyperscaler optical wins
bullets.body: Jefferies analyst Janardan models higher NOK growth and margin expansion in 2027-2028 from hyperscaler optical wins, with 2027 EPS approximately 15% ahead of consensus. This is framed as a structural re-rating catalyst rather than a near-term beat.

bullets.title: AAPL: iPhone price hikes could add ~5bp to core PCE; CMA advancing WebKit/NFC restrictions review
bullets.body: Analysis estimates Apple's planned price increases on MacBook, iPad, and iPhone could add ~5bp to core PCE inflation, with iPhone BOM up ~25% from memory costs alone. UK CMA is progressing work on removing Apple's WebKit browser restrictions and NFC access limitations, with consultation deadline July 28; Google has already introduced new Play Store terms allowing developer steering.
